name: dsi-studio-atk
summary: DSI Studio augmented fiber tracking and automatic segmentation for mapping major white matter pathways (Yeh, Neuroimage, 2020). The pathway includes projection, association, and commissural pathways.

parameters.description:
Specify which pathways to map.  You may assign partial names to select all matching bundles. Multiple names separated by comma can be included. If not specified, the default text is 

Fasciculus,Cingulum,Aslant,Cortico,Optic,Fornix,Corpus

The following is the list of available bundle for selection.
